aboutGame.title: What is Jujutsu School Anomaly?
paragraphs: Jujutsu School Anomaly is a Roblox survival horror inspection game from developer Centurion Kitchen. You take the night shift at Jujutsu High, where every visitor must be checked before they are allowed past the cursed barrier.

Inspect IDs and permits, compare each corridor against its baseline state, and report anything that has shifted. One missed anomaly or false report can break the containment loop, so the wiki covers visitor checks, anomaly types, shifts, endings, characters, and controls in one place.

explore.title: Explore the Jujutsu School Anomaly Wiki
explore.description: Eight focused modules cover the visitor checks, anomaly catalog, endings, characters, controls, and updates that matter during your Jujutsu High night shift.

modules.name: Jujutsu School Anomaly Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core night-shift loop: inspect visitors, check IDs and permits, and decide who is allowed to pass the cursed barrier at Jujutsu High.

highlights.detail: Read the campus layout and memorize the baseline look of each corridor before your first patrol.
Learn the core inputs: interact to inspect, sprint to escape, and the report key to log an anomaly.
Clear every room slowly, scanning floor level, eye level, and ceiling level for anything out of place.
Turn back and report the moment you spot a change, then reset the barrier to keep the loop alive.

modules.name: Jujutsu School Anomaly Visitor Guide
modules.description: Master the inspection rules for arriving visitors, from verifying identification and permits to spotting the warning signs of a disguised Anomaly.

highlights.label: Photo
highlights.detail: Check portrait fidelity for melting textures, chromatic fringing, or unnatural iris dilation.

highlights.label: Grade
highlights.detail: Compare the printed sorcerer grade against the visitor's aura and stated duties.

highlights.label: ID Code
highlights.detail: Confirm the campus prefix, 5-digit sequence, and clearance suffix match the roster.

highlights.label: Seal
highlights.detail: The spirit stamp should fluoresce deep crimson under spiritual UV light; a dull seal means a forgery.

highlights.label: Expiry
highlights.detail: Verify the validity window matches the current academic cycle before admitting anyone.

modules.name: Jujutsu School Anomaly Anomalies Guide
modules.description: A practical reference to the supernatural Anomalies that try to enter the school, with the warning signs and responses for each one.

highlights.label: Scrolls
highlights.detail: Inverted calligraphy scrolls in the dojo corridor display scrambled kanji characters.

highlights.label: Doorways
highlights.detail: A classroom sliding door appears on the wall where an emergency noticeboard should be.

highlights.label: Lockers
highlights.detail: Padlocks switch lockers, or metal doors sit slightly ajar with void-black interiors.

highlights.label: Chime
highlights.detail: A phantom bell chimes in the courtyard with no wind and no bell movement.

highlights.label: Mirror
highlights.detail: Restroom reflections lag one to two seconds behind your own movement.

highlights.label: Gate
highlights.detail: The red Torii gate at the courtyard shrine vanishes entirely from the scene.

modules.name: Jujutsu School Anomaly Ending Guide
modules.description: Follow the story progression and the objectives tied to each finale, from the standard evacuation route to the hidden true ending.

highlights.detail: Report eight consecutive loops with perfect anomaly accuracy to earn the Clean Evacuation ending.
Collect all four sacred talismans hidden across the campus to open the true route.
Purge the central shrine with the talismans to reach the Purified Dawn secret ending.
Avoid three false reports and keep sanity above zero, or you trigger Cursed Assimilation.

modules.name: Jujutsu School Anomaly Boss Guide
modules.description: Prepare for the major confrontation behind the school's mystery, with encounter information and survival strategies for the fight.

highlights.label: Prepare
highlights.detail: Bring talismans, a light source, and a full sanity meter before the final confrontation begins.

highlights.label: Pattern
highlights.detail: Read the boss wind-up animations and dash clear before the spatial cleave lands.

highlights.label: Adds
highlights.detail: Clear summoned curses first so they cannot pin you during the boss damage phase.

highlights.label: Retreat
highlights.detail: Break line of sight down the corridor when your cursed energy pool runs low.

modules.name: Jujutsu School Anomaly Characters
modules.description: Meet the characters and figures you encounter during the night shift, including Suguru Geto, the teachers, and the students.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Spatial Rift Sorcerer: teleport counters and a sweeping spatial cleave define the boss-fight meta.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Thunder Conduit: agile skirmisher whose electrical strikes interrupt heavy anomaly wind-ups.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Blood Artisan: trades health for piercing bleed damage, strong solo but unforgiving in raids.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Spectral Warden: barrier and knockback specialist that shines in coordinated groups.

modules.name: Jujutsu School Anomaly Controls
modules.description: A compact controls reference for movement, inspection, cursed sense, and reporting so you can react fast during a shift.

highlights.label: WASD
highlights.detail: Move forward, left, back, and right through the hallways and classrooms.

highlights.label: E
highlights.detail: Interact and inspect doors, lockers, notes, and other props.

highlights.label: Shift
highlights.detail: Sprint to evade curses; it drains stamina, so use it in short bursts.

highlights.label: Q
highlights.detail: Toggle cursed sense to highlight spiritual traces and subtle oddities.

highlights.label: F
highlights.detail: Flashlight or talisman light for dark corners and low-angle checks.

highlights.label: R
highlights.detail: Log the active anomaly on your terminal before you turn back.

faq.title: Jujutsu School Anomaly FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Jujutsu School Anomaly.

items.question: What is Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Jujutsu School Anomaly is a Roblox survival horror inspection game from developer Centurion Kitchen. You work the night shift at Jujutsu High, checking visitor IDs and permits and reporting supernatural anomalies before they break the containment loop.

items.question: How do I start my first night shift in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Learn the campus layout first, then walk each corridor slowly and compare it against its baseline state. Interact with props to inspect them, and use cursed sense to reveal spiritual traces you might otherwise miss.

items.question: How do I check visitor IDs in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Inspect six zones on every credential: portrait fidelity, sorcerer grade, the campus ID code, the spirit seal under UV light, the expiry window, and the micro-cursed line along the bottom border.

items.question: What should I do when I spot an anomaly in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Turn back immediately and log the anomaly on your terminal instead of walking past it. A single missed irregularity resets your progression counter, so report first and then reset the barrier.

items.question: How many endings does Jujutsu School Anomaly have?
items.answer: The story branches into five finales: Purified Dawn, Clean Evacuation, Cursed Assimilation, Forbidden Archive, and Endless Corridor. The true route requires all four sacred talismans and a shrine purge.
